svg.title: Theoretical knowledge / חכמות שכליות
svg.desc: Chapter 11, Hebrew pp237–239, English pp238–240. An orbiting heavenly body recalls Ramchal’s astronomy example: understanding a subject of reality as it is. The category includes other sciences, not astronomy alone. It does not mean tentative theory (סברא), intellectual priority, or one particular ground of evidence. The recommended exposition proceeds through subject, parts, causes, and attributes.
